# AI Consulting Services

> Compare discovery, integration and pilot deliverables from ten AI consultancies. Use a sample acceptance test to price the work your team actually needs.

Published by AY Automate, a seller of AI implementation services. [Editorial policy and corrections](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/#editorial).

## Guide
- [AI consulting services: scope your pilot before you buy](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/)
- [Write a brief for a paid AI pilot](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/worksheet/)
- [AI consulting pricing: compare two pilot quotes](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/ai-consulting-pricing/)

## Provider sources
- [AY Automate](https://www.ayautomate.com/case-studies): Workflow implementation. Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask for a pilot that takes one document from intake to a human-approved exception. Specify who labels the acceptance examples. This provider publishes the guide.
- [BCG](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence): Enterprise transformation. Combines strategy and applied AI. For a strategy purchase, request a sequenced opportunity list, one accountable sponsor per item and an explicit reason to decline the weakest item.
- [IBM Consulting](https://www.ibm.com/consulting/artificial-intelligence): Technology integration. Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Before funding integration, ask for a map of the source systems and a running test against one of your representative records.
- [Slalom](https://www.slalom.com/us/en/services/artificial-intelligence): AI implementation. Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Write down the smallest queue the team could launch. Request a cutover rehearsal and a training deliverable in the fixed scope.
- [McKinsey QuantumBlack](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-approach): Analytics and operating model. Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Request an operating-model design that names the decision owner and shows how a disputed model output is reviewed.
- [Accenture](https://www.accenture.com/en-us/support/state-texas-accenture-dir-artificial-intelligence): Enterprise delivery. Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Separate the statement of work into discovery, build and rollout. Mark which deliverable releases each payment.
- [Deloitte](https://www.deloitte.com/global/en/services/consulting/services/engineering-ai-data.html): Engineering and data. Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Specify which dataset must be usable at the end of engineering discovery. Ask for quality checks your engineer can repeat.
- [Capgemini](https://www.capgemini.com/news/client-stories/zf-friedrichshafen-establishes-a-global-rpa-service-in-a-single-year/): Process automation. Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. For a shared process service, request a backlog intake exercise with two departments competing for the same delivery capacity.
- [WeAreBrain](https://wearebrain.com/ai-automation-agency/): Workflow integration. Offers workflow automation and integration. If the service connects an ERP to another system, ask for one failed transaction to be replayed safely before acceptance.
- [Goodspeed](https://goodspeed.studio/n8n-agency): Operations workflows. Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for a working automation and a handover exercise. Price employee time spent learning the workflow as a buyer contribution.
- [Remote MCP](https://topaiconsultingservices.com/mcp): search_firms, compare_firms and recommend_providers.
